dialogue.content: こんにちは、相談員です。
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm the counselor.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 本日はお越しいただきありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you for coming in today.

dialogue.content: ご相談をはじめる前に、性別と年齢、あと何とお呼びすればいいか教えていただけますか？あだ名でも大丈夫です。
dialogue.English: Before we begin, could you please tell me your gender, age, and what you would like me to call you? A nickname is fine too.

dialogue.content: モカ　40代女性です。
dialogue.English: I'm Moka, a woman in my 40s.

dialogue.content: モカさんですね、ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Moka, got it. Thank you.

dialogue.content: それでは、本日はどのようなご相談ですか？
dialogue.English: So, what brings you in today?

dialogue.content: はい。姉が収入を考慮せず、買い物することが気になって。
dialogue.English: Yes. I'm concerned that my older sister shops without considering her income.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね、それは気がかりですね
dialogue.English: I see, that must be worrying.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: どのくらい買い物されるですか？
dialogue.English: How much shopping does she do?

dialogue.content: 欲しいと思ったものを考えずに買っています。
dialogue.English: She buys whatever she wants without a second thought.

dialogue.content: なるほど、衝動買いが多いのですね
dialogue.English: I see, so she does a lot of impulse buying.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 総額としてはけっこう多かったりするんですか？
dialogue.English: In total, does it add up to quite a lot?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね…それは困りますよね
dialogue.English: I see... That must be troubling.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お姉さんが衝動買いをするとモカさんはどのように思いますか？
dialogue.English: How do you feel when your sister makes these impulse purchases, Moka?

dialogue.content: またか　と思います。
dialogue.English: I think, 'Here we go again.'

dialogue.content: なるほど…ちょっとうんざりしてきますよね
dialogue.English: I see... it can get a bit exasperating.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: モカさんとしては、お姉さんにどうしてほしいですか？
dialogue.English: What would you like your sister to do, Moka?

dialogue.content: 収入と支出のバランスを考えてほしいです。
dialogue.English: I want her to think about balancing her income and expenses.

dialogue.content: そうですよね、お金がなくなるとどんどん不安が募りますものね…
dialogue.English: I understand. When money runs out, anxiety just keeps building, doesn't it...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 今お姉さんとはどのようなご関係なのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: What is your current relationship with your sister like?

dialogue.content: 特に関係に変化はありませんが、私が、やかましく言うので、嫌がられているとは思います。
dialogue.English: Our relationship hasn't really changed, but since I nag her about it, I think she's annoyed with me.

dialogue.content: なるほど、そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see, I understand.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 支出が多いとたしかに言いたくなるのは当然だと思います
dialogue.English: I think it's perfectly natural to want to say something when her spending is so high.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 日常生活には何か影響がでていますか？
dialogue.English: Is it affecting day-to-day life in any way?

dialogue.content: 本人の貯金がなくなっているくらいです。
dialogue.English: Just that her own savings are gone.

dialogue.content: なるほど、モカさんの生活には特に大きな影響はないですか？
dialogue.English: I see. So there hasn't been any major impact on your life, then?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、その点では安心しました
dialogue.English: I see. Well, I'm relieved to hear that, at least.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お姉さんに関して他に感じることはありますか？
dialogue.English: Is there anything else you're concerned about regarding your sister?

dialogue.content: このままだと、老後のための貯金もできないだろうと心配しています。
dialogue.English: I'm worried that if this continues, she won't be able to save for retirement.

dialogue.content: なるほど、そうですよね、不安になってきますよね
dialogue.English: I see. Of course, that would make you anxious.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お姉さんが老後どうなるかと考えると、どう思いますか？
dialogue.English: When you think about what will happen to your sister in her old age, how do you feel?

dialogue.content: 不安になります。
dialogue.English: I feel anxious.

dialogue.content: そうですね、不安でいろいろ考えてしまいますね
dialogue.English: Right. The anxiety makes you imagine all sorts of scenarios.

dialogue.content: モカさん自身にはどのように影響すると思われますか？
dialogue.English: How do you think it might affect you personally, Moka?

dialogue.content: 困って、頼られるのかなと思っています。
dialogue.English: I think she might end up in trouble and rely on me.

dialogue.content: なるほど、たしかにそうなりそうですね
dialogue.English: I see. That does seem likely.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 実際に頼られたとすると、モカさんはどうするとお考えですか？
dialogue.English: If she actually turned to you for help, what do you think you would do?

dialogue.content: それが不安でご相談しています。
dialogue.English: That's what I'm anxious about, and that's why I came for counseling.

dialogue.content: そうですよね、では一緒に考えていきましょう
dialogue.English: I understand. Let's think it through together.

dialogue.content: 私もそんなに余裕があるわけではないので、頼られても困ります。
dialogue.English: I'm not that financially secure myself, so it would be a problem if she came to depend on me.

dialogue.content: お願いします。
dialogue.English: Yes, please.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、不安が募るばかりですよね
dialogue.English: I see. The anxiety just keeps building, doesn't it?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 「余裕がないので頼られても困る」といったことは、お姉さんに言ったことはありますか？
dialogue.English: Have you told your sister something like, 'I don't have much leeway, so it would be difficult if you depended on me'?

dialogue.content: 買い物ばかりしてて、貯金がなくなったらどうするの？　私は払えないよということはあります。
dialogue.English: I have said things like, "What are you going to do when your savings are gone from all this shopping? I can't pay for you."

dialogue.content: なるほど、お金の面をお伝えしたのですね
dialogue.English: I see, so you've communicated the financial boundary.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 「困る」「不安だ」といったような感情面のことはいかがですか？
dialogue.English: What about the emotional side? Have you told her how it makes you feel, that you're "worried" or "anxious"?

dialogue.content: お姉ちゃんが困るよということはありますが、私が困ると伝えたことはないです。
dialogue.English: I've told her that *she* will be in trouble, but I've never said that *I* will be.

dialogue.content: 私が困る場面がまだないので
dialogue.English: Because there hasn't been a situation where I'm in trouble yet.

dialogue.content: なるほど、現状を基準にお伝えしたということなのですね
dialogue.English: I see, so you've been communicating based on the current situation.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 今モカさんは不安がかなりある状態ですよね
dialogue.English: Right now, you're feeling quite anxious, aren't you?

dialogue.content: その不安をお姉さんに全部伝えたら、おねえさんはどう反応すると思いますか？
dialogue.English: If you were to tell your sister all about this anxiety, how do you think she would react?

dialogue.content: 買い物が、だんだん高価なものに移行してきているので
dialogue.English: Her purchases are gradually shifting to more expensive things, so...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 特に反応しないと思います。
dialogue.English: I don't think she would react at all.

dialogue.content: なるほど、反応なしだとよけいに不安になりますよね
dialogue.English: I see. A lack of reaction would only make you more anxious, wouldn't it?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 承知しました。今までのおはなしを一旦まとめたいと思いますがよろしいですか？
dialogue.English: Understood. I'd like to summarize what we've discussed so far, if that's alright.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: モカさんのお姉さんは老後を考えず高額な買い物を繰り返しています
dialogue.English: Your sister repeatedly makes expensive purchases without considering her retirement.

dialogue.content: どれだけ言ってもやめてくれない
dialogue.English: No matter what you say, she won't stop.

dialogue.content: もし将来金銭面で頼られてもモカさんが困る
dialogue.English: If she were to rely on you financially in the future, it would cause problems for you.

dialogue.content: 不安がつのるばかりで、お姉さんに不安を伝えても反応はないだろう
dialogue.English: Your anxiety keeps growing, and you feel that even if you expressed your anxiety to your sister, she wouldn't react.

dialogue.content: このような感じだと思うのですがいかがですか？
dialogue.English: Does that sound about right?

dialogue.content: はい。だんだんと高価なものに移行してきています。
dialogue.English: Yes. And her purchases are gradually getting more expensive.

dialogue.content: そうですよね…承知しました
dialogue.English: Right... I understand.

dialogue.content: すみません、もうひとつだけお聞かせください
dialogue.English: Excuse me, may I ask just one more thing?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 家族の老後の面倒を見る、ということに関して、どう思いますか？
dialogue.English: What are your thoughts on taking care of a family member in their old age?

dialogue.content: 姉のということでしょうか？今のままでは無理です。
dialogue.English: Do you mean my sister? As things are now, it's impossible.

dialogue.content: なるほど、現状ではそう思いますよね
dialogue.English: I see. That's understandable given the current situation.

dialogue.content: モカさんの現状が変われば面倒を見てもいいとお考えですか？
dialogue.English: If your own situation were to change, would you consider taking care of her?

dialogue.content: 私の現状と言われますとどのような？
dialogue.English: What do you mean by my situation?

dialogue.content: 例えばモカさんに金銭的な余裕ができたら、いかがですか？
dialogue.English: For example, if you had more financial security, how would you feel then?

dialogue.content: そうですね。余裕があり、生活していける状態でしたら、今と同じように近くで見守ることはできますが、丸抱えということなのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Let's see. If I were financially comfortable and able to live without worry, I could continue to look out for her from nearby as I do now. But are you asking if I would support her completely?

dialogue.content: いえいえ、丸抱えということではありません
dialogue.English: Oh no, I don't mean supporting her completely.

dialogue.content: とても責任感のある方だと私は感じましたので、念のために質問をさせていただいたんです
dialogue.English: I only asked because I sense that you are a very responsible person.

dialogue.content: ご家族を大事にしたいという想いがあると強く思いました
dialogue.English: I got the strong impression that you want to cherish your family.

dialogue.content: 近くで見守ることはできますし、ご飯を食べに行ったりなどは可能だと思います。しかし、債務を抱えられるとそれは、困ります。
dialogue.English: I can look out for her, and we could go out to eat and things like that. But if she gets into debt, that would be a problem.

dialogue.content: ええ、債務に関してはそのとおりだと私も思います
dialogue.English: Yes, I completely agree with you regarding the debt.

dialogue.content: 私が思う事をお伝えしたいと思いますがよろしいですか？
dialogue.English: I'd like to share my thoughts, if that's okay.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お姉さんの金銭面に関して
dialogue.English: Regarding your sister's financial situation...

dialogue.content: モカさんは面倒を見なくていいと私は思います
dialogue.English: I don't think you need to take financial responsibility for her.

dialogue.content: 法的にもということですか？
dialogue.English: Do you mean legally as well?

dialogue.content: たとえおねんさんが「困った」と頼ってきたとしても、「助けられないよ」と伝えていいと思います
dialogue.English: Even if your sister comes to you for help, saying she's in trouble, I think it's okay for you to tell her, "I can't help you."

dialogue.content: 法的というのはどのようなことですか？
dialogue.English: What do you mean by 'legally'?

dialogue.content: 姉が債務を抱えた場合、親族には支払い義務が生じるのか否か　すみませんこれは自分で調べてみます。
dialogue.English: If my sister gets into debt, are relatives legally obligated to pay it? Sorry, I'll look this up myself.

dialogue.content: ええ、その法律はありますね、それはとても気になると思います
dialogue.English: Yes, there are laws concerning that. I can imagine that's a big concern for you.

dialogue.content: 私も専門ではありませんが、その法律には「但し書き」がありましてね
dialogue.English: I'm not an expert, but that law has a 'proviso.'

dialogue.content: 「ただし、親類に金銭的な余裕がなければその限りではない」というものがあるんですね
dialogue.English: There's one that says something to the effect of, "however, this does not apply if the relative does not have the financial means to help."

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: ですので、絶対的に債務を負わなければならないものとは限らないんですね
dialogue.English: So, it's not always a case where you are absolutely required to take on the debt.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: そのような法律があると…ものすごく負担に感じるし、不安になりますよね…
dialogue.English: Knowing a law like that exists... it must feel like an immense burden and cause a lot of anxiety.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: もし法律に関してさらに明確にしたいとお考えなら、法律専門にご相談されるといいと思います
dialogue.English: If you would like more clarity on the legal aspect, I suggest consulting a legal professional.

dialogue.content: わかりました。
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: あと、お姉さんのと関係のおはなしを少しだけ。
dialogue.English: Also, a little about your relationship with your sister.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: ↑お姉さんとの　の間違いです
dialogue.English: Apologies, that was a typo. I meant "your relationship with your sister."

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 悲しいですが…おそらくモカさんがどれだけ訴えても、お姉さんの浪費癖は現状のままだと思います…
dialogue.English: This is sad to say... but it's likely that no matter how much you plead with her, your sister's spending habits will probably remain as they are.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: お姉さんの支出はお姉さん自身の問題ですので
dialogue.English: Your sister's spending is her own problem.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Right.

dialogue.content: モカさんは問題を抱えないほうがいいと思います
dialogue.English: I think it's better for you not to take on that problem as your own.

dialogue.content: お姉さんの問題は、お姉さん自身で解決してもらいましょう
dialogue.English: Let your sister solve her own problems.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: もう言いたいことは一通りお伝えしたと思いますし、ご自身の生活がなにより大切ですから
dialogue.English: I think you've already told her everything you wanted to say, and your own life is what's most important.

dialogue.content: 私からは以上になります、いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: That's all from me. How do you feel about this?

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: こちらこそありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you as well.
